question: The headquarters of the National Institute of Oceanography of India is located at _______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Institute of Oceanography (NIO) with its headquarters at **Dona Paula, Goa**.
 
• Its regional centres at **Kochi**, **Mumbai **and **Visakhapatnam**, are one of the 37 constituent laboratories of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), New Delhi.
 
• NIO was established on** 1 January 1966** following the International Indian Ocean Expedition (IIOE) in **the1960**.
 
• **Prof. Sunil Kumar Singh **is the current **Director **of the NIO.
 
• He was conferred with the **Lifetime Achievement Award** of the Indian Society of Applied Geochemists (ISAG) in December 2022, in recognition of his contributions to Earth Sciences in general and applied Geochemistry in particular.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Anthropological Survey of India,1945 - Kolkata
 
• Archaeological Survey of India, 1861 - New Delhi
 
• National School of Drama, 1959 - New Delhi
 
• Sahitya Academy, 1954 - New Delhi
 
• National Library of India - Kolkata
